headline: The counter that counts negative
lede: Minesweeper's mine counter now runs below zero exactly like the original's hardware display — over-flag the field and it tells you, game-wide, that flags are wrong.

notes.text: Signed mine counter shipped (#3021 → main a9b39f4, prod-verified): mineCounter(s) in the engine (floor −99, pure read), a minus glyph in the LED family, sweepcheck pins the −1 signature and the floor — 107/107, mutant counter-clamp dies.

Never-dry derivation walked honestly: no steer/next/queue, QA-borrow blocked by three live QA sessions, flagship gaps spent — idle-kick aimed at the weakest shelf title and the fix shipped orthogonally to what QA holds.

Filed #3023 for QA: the #3011 pips leg races plantHere's double-click — a quiet box turns the harness's own second click into a real chord rejection (seeds decide, not the rule). Fixture-side; QA claimed it minutes later.
#2975 bit a third time: rule-5 merge exits 1 after a successful squash-merge while the stale qa-mini-cap worktree squats local main — verify via gh pr view, then detach; reaping that worktree is due.

look.text: Over-flag COLT and watch the HUD read −0N, like the 1990 original
